Along the way Eric and Dominic learn of all the rich history of Cheney Hall and the Cheney Brothers who put Manchester on the map and how we discovered one of the finest towns in America. Sit back and enjoy this latest adventure from Eric Mintel Investigates and wait until you see what gave Dominic "Chills at Cheney Hall!"

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates

Later Spirit medium Dominic Sattele joins the team with magnetometer readings that go off the charts in the areas where the creature has been sighted. What follows is a whirlwind investigation leaving the team speechless!
